summary: Bilingual first-party discovery and current JavaScript/configuration inspection identified Guangdong's official Tianditu public map portal. Its exposed public configuration points to general administrative/base mapping; the inspected hosted vector-tile metadata endpoint returned Token Required. No public cadastral parcel ID or polygon was returned, and no local registry custodian with open parcel geometry was evidenced.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed bilingual discovery queries and bounded requests, including URLs, statuses, configuration observations, and limits, are recorded in city-11862-xixi.json.

custodians.name: Guangdong Natural Resources Department / Guangdong Map Institute
custodians.scope: Provincial public geographic map portal and general map services.
custodians.evidence: Official Guangdong Tianditu portal HTML, current configuration, and JavaScript were retrieved anonymously.

custodians.name: National Geomatics Center of China / Ministry of Natural Resources ecosystem
custodians.scope: National geographic-information resource catalog landing page only.
custodians.evidence: Official webmap.cn catalog landing page was retrieved; no Xixi parcel service was verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned and source-proven
registryBasis: No city/local cadastral map, registry, procedure, or public parcel geometry endpoint was evidenced. Provincial and national map portals were treated as general map/catalog sources, not as a qualified local registry.
coverageLimits: Only general portal configuration and a token-required hosted vector-tile endpoint were verified; no parcel geometry was returned.
The exact WUP point [22.9921492392626, 116.178405729153] was not shifted and no exact-point absence inference was made.
No citywide or countrywide cadastral coverage qualification was performed.
Unsafe owner, address, titleholder, tax, account, and other personal/property-rights fields were not requested.
uncertainty: The public hosted map endpoint required a token, and no authentication or bypass was attempted.
The portal may have restricted or separate cadastral services not exposed in the public landing/configuration path.
The WUP locality identity may require a more specific administrative alias in a later attempt.
doNotInfer: No geometry is not evidence that Xixi has no parcels.
A token-required route or general map portal is not evidence of cadastral absence.
The packet is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
